summary: This configuration section tells Black, a Python code formatter, to format code with a line length of 120 characters and target Python version 3.13. Black is a tool that automatically reformats Python code to follow consistent style rules.

explanations.1: This starts a configuration section for the Black tool within a TOML configuration file (TOML is a simple config format similar to INI files).
explanations.4: Black will break lines longer than 120 characters, rather than using its default of 88 characters.
explanations.8: This tells Black to format code compatible with Python 3.13 specifically; multiple versions can be listed in the array if you need to support multiple Python versions.
